source: Original 15 locked from morphacc_gold.json (SQUOIA FST + manual). Remaining 485 sampled from SQUOIA Quechua treebank CoNLL (a-rios/squoia release 31-07-2015). Morphemes reconstructed from hyphen-suffix CoNLL tokens, NFC lowercased. Gold, not FST silver.
metric: morpheme_boundary_accuracy = |pred_morphemes ∩ silver_morphemes| / |silver_morphemes| (string overlap, not character offsets)
